title.zh-Hans: Abdomen · 腹部 · 肚子是我们的领地吗？

gloss.en: The part of the body between the thorax and pelvis; belly
gloss.zh-Hans: 胸部与骨盆之间的身体部位；腹部、肚子

meaning.en: 腹部/腹 is the standard formal translation; 肚子 is the standard everyday equivalent and the selected Chinese mapping. The isolated form 肚 dù is additionally preserved as an experimental phonetic-semantic candidate.
meaning.zh-Hans: “腹部／腹”是标准正式译法，“肚子”是标准日常对应词，也是本条选定的主要汉语 Mapping；单字“肚”dù 另作为实验性语音—语义候选保留。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Reviewed lexical equivalent with separate phonetic-semantic candidate

rationale.en: The ordinary lexical equivalence is strong in the BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY field. The sound comparison is independently low-confidence and does not imply common origin.
rationale.zh-Hans: 普通词义对应在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场中明确成立；声音比较另列为低置信候选，不暗示共同来源。

summary.en: English and French abdomen are learned borrowings from Latin abdōmen, with the oblique stem abdōmin-. The deeper origin of the Latin word is uncertain. Therefore ab.dom.en is not accepted as a historical segmentation. English abdominal and French abdominal/abdominale are derivatives of abdomen, not evidence for a dom root shared with dome or domain.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语和法语 abdomen 都是源自拉丁语 abdōmen 的学术借词，其斜格词干为 abdōmin-。该拉丁词更深层来源仍不确定，因此不把 ab.dom.en 接受为历史构词切分。英语 abdominal 与法语 abdominal／abdominale 是 abdomen 的派生词，不能据此推出它们与 dome 或 domain 共享 dom 词根。

claim.en: English abdomen was borrowed from Middle French and Latin; Latin abdōmen meant the belly or paunch and is of uncertain origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen 借自中古法语与拉丁语；拉丁语 abdōmen 指腹部或大肚子，其来源不确定。

claim.en: French abdomen is a learned sixteenth-century borrowing from Latin abdomen; French abdominal is derived from French abdomen with the adjectival suffix -al.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是十六世纪从拉丁语 abdomen 借入的学术词；法语 abdominal 由法语 abdomen 加形容词后缀 -al 派生。

claim.en: A derivation from Latin abdere ‘hide, conceal’ has been proposed, but major dictionary treatment regards it as doubtful; no deeper decomposition is asserted here.
claim.zh-Hans: 有人提出它可能与拉丁语 abdere“隐藏”有关，但主要词典认为这一解释可疑；本记录不主张任何更深层构词切分。

claim.en: Domain, domestic, dominant and dominate belong to a house/master family through Latin domus, dominus, dominium and dominari. Architectural dome follows a Greek/late-Latin/Romance building-roof path. These histories do not derive from abdomen or from a belly sense.
claim.zh-Hans: domain、domestic、dominant、dominate 经拉丁语 domus、dominus、dominium、dominari 属于“家屋／主人”词族。建筑义 dome 则走希腊语—晚期拉丁语—罗曼语的建筑／屋顶路径。这些词史都不源自 abdomen，也不源自“肚子”义。

summary.en: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ and 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ meet clearly in BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY meaning. Sound support is only partial: the second syllable begins with English /d/, while Mandarin pinyin d represents an unaspirated voiceless coronal stop [t]; abdomen also contains /b m n/ with no counterpart in 肚, and 肚 has lexical tone.
summary.zh-Hans: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 与“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 词义上明确相交。声音支持仅属局部：abdomen 第二音节以英语 /d/ 起首，而普通话拼音 d 表示不送气清冠音 [t]；abdomen 另有 /b m n/，在“肚”中无对应，并且“肚”带词汇声调。

claim.en: The proposed domen/dom ↔ 肚 comparison reduces to a partial coronal-stop resemblance plus a strong semantic intersection; it is not the same consonant skeleton.
claim.zh-Hans: 所提 domen／dom ↔“肚”的比较可归结为局部冠音塞音近似加明确语义交点；二者并不是相同的辅音骨架。

summary.en: The authorial chain ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL is a coherent imaginative model, not a historical derivation. The Chinese hand/control imagery is preserved as a cross-cultural cognitive note without expanding it into an origin claim.
summary.zh-Hans: 作者提出的 ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 是连贯的想象模型，不是历史派生链。汉语“手—支配”意象作为跨文化认知札记保留，不扩展成词源主张。

claim.en: A convex belly can be imagined through the shape of a dome and as a bodily container or personal domain.
claim.zh-Hans: 凸起的肚子可借圆顶形状来想象，也可被想象为身体容器或个人领域。

claim.en: Chinese expressions such as 手下 and the image 翻手为云，覆手为雨 associate hand imagery with subordination or control; this note is cultural-semantic, not etymological.
claim.zh-Hans: “手下”以及“翻手为云，覆手为雨”的意象把“手”与从属或支配相联；此处只作文化语义札记，不作词源解释。

summary.en: The proposed abdomen → dome → domain/control chain is retained as an authored association but rejected as a historical derivation. Similar spelling does not merge distinct etymological families.
summary.zh-Hans: 所提 abdomen → dome → domain／control 链作为作者联想保留，但作为历史派生关系不成立。拼写相似不能合并不同词源族。

claim.en: Segmenting abdomen as ab.dom.en and treating dom as the productive root is unsupported by the attested Latin form and its uncertain deeper origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 把 abdomen 切分为 ab.dom.en 并把 dom 当作能产词根，得不到已见拉丁语形式及其不确定深层来源的支持。

claim.en: Dome ‘rounded roof’, belly roundness, domain and control may form a literary-cognitive association, but the chain is not the historical source of the words.
claim.zh-Hans: dome“圆顶”、肚子的圆凸、domain 与 control 可构成文学—认知联想，但不是这些词的历史来源链。

claim.en: English abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ contains /d/ at the onset of its second syllable; Mandarin 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ begins with the pinyin d sound, phonetically an unaspirated [t].
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 的第二音节以 /d/ 起首；普通话“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 以拼音 d 所记的不送气 [t] 起首。

limitations.en: The stops share coronal place but differ in voicing and phonological system. /b m n/ and Mandarin tone are unmatched, so d-m or d-m-n cannot be claimed as a shared consonantal skeleton.
limitations.zh-Hans: 两者塞音同属冠音部位，但清浊及音系不同；/b m n/ 与普通话声调均无对应，因此不能宣称共享 d-m 或 d-m-n 辅音骨架。

semantic_structure.relation: BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY; speculative association: ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL; cross-cultural note: HAND → CONTROL

relation_to_entry.en: Direct derivative of abdomen; genuinely part of the same etymological family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: abdomen 的直接派生词；确属同一历史词族。

relation_to_entry.en: French abdomen is a learned Latin borrowing; abdominal/abdominale derives from it.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是拉丁学术借词；abdominal／abdominale 由它派生。

related_words.family: Greek dôma → Late Latin/Romance architectural path

relation_to_entry.en: Associated by rounded shape and spelling only; not derived from abdomen.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 仅因圆凸形状与拼写产生联想；并非由 abdomen 派生。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs to the ownership/master family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于所有权／主人词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs directly to the house/home family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 直接属于家屋／家庭词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs to the master/rule family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于主人／统治词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs to the master/rule family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于主人／统治词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

claim.en: abdomen and 肚 dù may support a limited modern-form association through a coronal stop and the shared BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY field.
claim.zh-Hans: abdomen 与“肚”dù 可能通过冠音塞音及共享的 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场形成有限的现代词形联想。

testability.en: Test sound similarity and semantic fit separately with blinded ratings, unrelated body-part controls and matched non-body words.
testability.zh-Hans: 用盲法评分分别检验声音相似与语义适配，并设置无关身体部位词和匹配的非身体词作为对照。

claim.en: ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL may function as a literary-cognitive chain even though it is not a historical word-family derivation.
claim.zh-Hans: ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 可作为文学—认知链发挥作用，即使它不是历史词族派生链。

counterexamples: abdomen is not built from dome

testability.en: Evaluate as a metaphor-elicitation or literary-reception pattern, not as etymology.
testability.zh-Hans: 应作为隐喻诱发或文学接受模式评价，而不是词源假说。

text.en: Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the dudou over our bellies look like? We seem to have forgotten to wonder. A child's face is bright with freshness. Girls, when nature gave you the moon's gentle radiance, it did not forget to let you walk with the moon. Boys, when nature gave you sunlit faces, it did not forget to let you rise and fall with the sun.
text.zh-Hans: 肚子是我们的领地吗？当我们都是孩提时代，那在腹部上面的肚兜是啥模样？似乎都忘记想了。孩提时代的脸庞是水灵灵的。那女孩子们，大自然在给你们柔媚如月般的皎洁的时候，不忘记让你随着那月行走。那男孩子们，大自然在给你们阳光的面庞的时候，也没有忘记给你们随那太阳起落。

translations.status: Lightly edited from the author's raw draft

evidence_boundary.en: The domain question, dudou, childhood, moon and sun are literary images. They remain searchable and attributable to Jinkai Liu but are not lexical, historical or phonetic evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 领地之问、肚兜、孩童、月亮与太阳均属文学意象。它们可检索并归于 Jinkai Liu，但不构成词义、历史或语音证据。

editorial_notes.en: Standard translation and the experimental cross-language mapping are explicitly distinct: 腹部/腹 is formal, 肚子 is everyday, and isolated 肚 dù is the phonetic-semantic candidate.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 标准翻译与实验性跨语言 mapping 明确分开：“腹部／腹”为正式译法，“肚子”为日常对应，单字“肚”dù 才是语音—语义候选。

editorial_notes.en: The apparent dom spelling is not used to collapse abdomen, dome and the domus/dominus family into one root.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 不因表面共有 dom 拼写，就把 abdomen、dome 与 domus／dominus 词族合并为一个词根。

source.author: Jinkai Liu
source.normalization: Pronunciations and parts of speech normalized; standard Chinese translations distinguished from the experimental 肚 mapping; raw English retained verbatim.
source.raw_note: 英语：abdomen ['æbdəmən] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.dom.en；abdominal [æb'dɔminəl] a. 腹；ab.dom.inal；domain n. 领地；dome n. 圆顶，肚子就是圆形的；domestic a. 领域内的；dominant a. 主导的；dominate v. 支配。法语：ab.dom.en [abdomen] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.domin.al,e [abdominal] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；abdominal (masculine)，abdominale (feminine)。汉语：肚【du】n. 肚子。备注：以上这些词汇大概都是由 dome 圆顶的根词演化而来的。也可以与肚 du 子的意思对应得上。主导等等词汇我们一般用手的词汇构成，例如手下，翻手为云覆手为雨。也许英语法语词汇用与肚子有关的词汇表达统治主导的意思。中文原文：肚子是我们的领地吗？当我们都是孩提时代，那在腹部上面的肚兜是啥模样？似乎都忘记想了。孩提时代的脸庞是水灵灵的。那女孩子们，大自然在给你们柔媚如月般的皎洁的时候。不忘记让你随着那月行走。那男孩子们，大自然在给你们阳光的面庞的时候，也没有忘记给你们随那太阳起落。用户英文原稿：Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the bellyband look like? I seem to have forgotten it. The face of a child is watery. Girls, when nature gave you the softness of the moon, it did not forget to let you walk with the moon. Boys, when nature gave you the sunny face, it also did not forget to let you rise and fall with the sun.
